concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-android-terminals-deploy-apps-profiles]] — Adyen Customer Area Android app-profile guide captured 2026-09-15 for matching conditions, Ready version selection, boarding/maintenance application, install/uninstall effects, and API/manual overwrite.
warnings: No-condition profiles cover all terminals in the company account; changing a matching profile can uninstall apps and close an open app when its version updates.
The raw snapshot does not prove a specific terminal's current app inventory, deployment success, model eligibility, app approval or payment execution.
